review_methods: Inspection of root-produced receipts and logs
review_boundary.auditor_authorship: This reviewer authored the fresh audit_payload_stage.py. Its inclusion here is author self-review, not a separately independent code review of that file.
review_boundary.other_helper_authorship: The deployment adapter, application identity/harness and root supervisor/custody helpers were authored by other agents; this review is independent of those authors.
review_boundary.separate_auditor_review_reported_by_root: Root reports reading the entire new auditor and immutable core, and a separate safety agent reports peer-reading the frozen auditor without a critical finding. This receipt does not substitute for or invent a separate peer-review artifact.
review_boundary.qualification: A later independent audit of actual deployment evidence and live installed/backup/profile bytes is still required. This static receipt does not mark pending stage, swap, installed application or publication gates passed.
